attchmntText: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Company Profile:Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZL) is the India s largest commercial port company with over 25% market share. It is also among the top 5 fastest growing port players in the world and has been registering a remarkable 19% CAGR growth over the last 10 years. Its flagship multi-commodity port at Mundra is not only the largest commercial port in the country, but is also an emerging integrated industrial area. APSEZL is among the top 50 Nifty companies and has retained consistent investment grade since FY16. APSEZL is covered by various international rating agencies such as Fitch Ratings and S&P Global Ratings which gave BBB- rating with stable outlook and Moody s Investor Service which gave Baa3 with a similar outlook.APSEZL has a unique and integrated business model with three verticals   Ports, Logistics and Industrial Areas. Its presence across 10 strategically located ports and terminals on both the western and eastern coastline of India offer the most widespread national footprint with excellent hinterland connectivity. Such leading position in ports is supplemented by its logistics arm   Adani Logistics, which owns and operates logistics parks, runs freight trains connecting ports and hinterland locations and also provides integrated solutions to industries through warehousing facilities. APSEZL is continuously expanding its presence across the coastline through organic capacity expansion at existing ports and also through new ports. It is currently developing a transshipment port at Vizhinjam, Kerala. The Company s integrated services across three verticals, i.e. Ports, Logistics and SEZ, has enabled it to forge alliances with leading Indian businesses making APSEZ an undisputed leader in the Indian ports & logistics sector.'.
